name: Thai Peanut Chicken Snack Plate
steps: Whisk the peanut butter, coconut milk, and a squeeze of lime into a smooth satay-style sauce.
Slice the cooked chicken breast and cut the cucumber and carrot into sticks.
Toss the sliced chicken with the peanut sauce until coated.
Arrange on a plate and serve with the cucumber and carrot for dipping.
